judge_set.sample_reply: {"missing_facts":[{"text":"ends in June","reason":"The summary does not say when the work ends."}]}

error_catalog.name: omitted-date
error_catalog.description: A date or a time that the summary leaves out. Example: the work ends in June.

error_catalog.name: omitted-number
error_catalog.description: A number or an amount that the summary leaves out. Example: the project costs 2 million euros.

error_catalog.name: omitted-event
error_catalog.description: A thing that happens or a rule that the summary leaves out. Example: entry is free on Sundays.

error_catalog.name: omitted-outcome
error_catalog.description: A result or a conclusion that the summary leaves out. Example: the effect was strongest in people over 60.

fields.source_text: The library opens at 8 a.m. and closes at 6 p.m. on weekdays. Members can borrow up to five books for three weeks. Late returns cost 20 cents per day.
fields.summary: The library is open from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. on weekdays. Members may borrow five books for three weeks. Each late day costs 20 cents.

fields.source_text: The city council approved the new bike lane on Main Street. Work starts in March and ends in June. The project costs 2 million euros.
fields.summary: The city council approved a new bike lane on Main Street. Work starts in March.

expected_errors.description: The summary does not say when the work ends.
The summary leaves out the cost.

fields.source_text: Maria joined the company in 2019 as a designer. In 2022 she became the head of the design team. She now leads six people.
fields.summary: Maria joined as a designer in 2019, became head of the design team in 2022 and now leads six people.

fields.source_text: The museum reopens on 4 May after two years of repairs. Entry is free on the first Sunday of each month. A new hall shows paintings from the 19th century.
fields.summary: The museum reopens on 4 May after two years of repairs. A new hall shows paintings.

expected_errors.fragment: Entry is free on the first Sunday of each month
expected_errors.description: The summary leaves out the free entry.
The summary does not say the age of the paintings.

fields.source_text: The train to Kraków leaves at 7:15 from platform 3. The trip takes two hours and ten minutes. Tickets can be bought in the app.
fields.summary: The 7:15 train to Kraków leaves from platform 3, takes two hours and ten minutes, and tickets are sold in the app.

fields.source_text: The study followed 400 adults for five years. People who walked daily had fewer heart problems. The effect was strongest in people over 60.
fields.summary: A study followed 400 adults for five years and found that daily walking goes with fewer heart problems.

expected_errors.description: The summary leaves out which group gained most.

fields.source_text: The bakery sells bread, cakes and coffee. It opens at 6 a.m. every day except Monday. Cash is not accepted; customers pay by card.
fields.summary: The bakery sells bread, cakes and coffee and opens at 6 a.m.

expected_errors.description: The summary does not say the bakery is closed on Monday.
The summary leaves out the payment rule.

fields.source_text: The software update fixes a login bug. It also makes the app start faster. Users must restart the app after the update.
fields.summary: The update fixes a login bug and speeds up the start of the app; users need to restart afterwards.

fields.source_text: The school trip goes to the science park on Friday. Pupils need a packed lunch and warm clothes. Parents must sign the form by Wednesday.
fields.summary: The school trip goes to the science park on Friday and pupils need a packed lunch.

expected_errors.description: The summary leaves out the clothes.
The summary leaves out the form and its date.

fields.source_text: The company reported a profit of 3 million euros in 2023. Sales grew by 8 percent. The board plans to hire 40 new people.
fields.summary: The company reported a profit of 3 million euros in 2023, and sales grew by 8 percent. The board plans to hire 40 new people.

definition.name: Completeness
definition.description: Checks that the judge finds every fact of a source text that a summary leaves out.
definition.limitations: Measures only the kinds of omission injected into the test data.
definition.output_format: A JSON object with a list of the missing facts, each with its text (in the words of the source) and a reason.

match_clear_share.description: Share of the fragment's words a finding must contain to count as a clear match.

match_partial_share.description: Share above which a finding counts as a partial match.

match_min_word_length.description: Shorter words are ignored when comparing.

measures.name: False-positive rate
measures.description: Findings that are not errors, out of all findings.
